report.title: Red Lions edge Blue Sharks 3-2 in extra-time chaos
report.summary: Red Lions won 3-2 after extra time in a match that kept flipping back and forth: Fox scored in the 28th minute, Gray equalized in the 62nd, Reid put Red Lions back ahead in the 95th, Cruz leveled again in the 105th, and Bell of Blue Sharks put the ball into Blue Sharks' own net in the 113th to make the final score 3-2. Red Lions controlled most of the match and finished with the stronger numbers, while the closing stretch was frantic and one-sided in their favor.

sections.text: Red Lions won 3-2 after extra time in a wild match that kept snapping back and forth. Fox opened the scoring in the 28th minute from Lane’s pass, Gray levelled for Blue Sharks in the 62nd, Reid restored Red Lions’ lead in the 95th after Rook’s assist, and Cruz pulled Blue Sharks level again in the 105th from Wells’ pass. Bell of Blue Sharks then put the ball into Blue Sharks' own net in the 113th minute, and that was the final goal of the night.

Red Lions finished with the stronger overall profile: 69% possession, 85% of the territory, 838 passes completed at 93% accuracy, and 110 final-third entries. Blue Sharks stayed alive with 2 goals from 15 shots and 5 big chances, but Red Lions generated more volume with 27 shots, 11 on target, and 6 big chances. The last 10 minutes were especially one-sided, with Red Lions at 91% field tilt and 79% possession.

Red Lions won 3-2 after extra time in a match that kept swinging from one side to the other. Fox put Red Lions ahead in the 28th minute, Gray equalized in the 62nd, Reid restored the lead in the 95th, and Cruz made it 2-2 in the 105th. Bell of Blue Sharks put the ball into Blue Sharks' own net in the 113th minute, and the closing spell was tense and messy right through the final whistle.

fan.title: Red Lions edge a wild extra-time thriller
paragraphs: Red Lions won 3-2 after extra time in a match that swung back and forth before Bell’s own goal in the 113th minute put the home side ahead for good. Fox opened the scoring in the 28th minute from Lane’s pass, Gray levelled for Blue Sharks in the 62nd, and Reid restored Red Lions’ lead in the 95th after Rook’s assist. Cruz dragged Blue Sharks back level in the 105th from Wells’ pass, before Bell put the ball into Blue Sharks’ own net.

Red Lions controlled the match for long spells and finished with 69% possession, 85% of the territory, and 776 completed passes from 838. Blue Sharks stayed in the contest through direct moments and a few sharp breaks, but Red Lions had far more of the ball, more attacks in the final third, and more chances overall, with 27 shots to 15 and 6 big chances to 5.

The turning point came in extra time when Red Lions kept the pressure on and forced the mistake that decided the scoreline. Reid’s goal at 95' looked like it might settle it, but Cruz answered quickly; in the end, Red Lions’ sustained control and late push made the difference in a chaotic finish.

The turning point was the spell in extra time after Reid’s goal, when Red Lions kept forcing the issue and Blue Sharks were pinned back. Even though Blue Sharks found a second equaliser through Cruz, Red Lions stayed on top in the final stretch and the own goal settled a frantic finish for the home side.

FALSE: "The turning point came ... when ... forced the mistake that settled the game" / "decisive own goal" / "decided it" are not allowed before or at full time unless they refer simply to the final score; here the wording attributes decisive match-defining force to the own goal rather than just reporting the final goal.
